correctness.rationale: The helper delivers a usable polling loop with correct env defaults (INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT), allow-list loading, documented exit codes, and RESULT=/HEAD= lines on CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, and SHA_CHANGED paths. However, CONVERGED only checks for zero unresolved allow-listed bot review threads and never determines whether participating allow-listed bots are terminal for the current head, so it can return CONVERGED before expected bots finish. Head SHA is fetched in a separate gh call before the snapshot call rather than atomically bracketing one snapshot. TIMEOUT emits RESULT=TIMEOUT without HEAD= even when a SHA was available earlier in the loop.

quality.rationale: Shell style is repo-consistent (set -euo pipefail, clear header contract, lowercase allow-list matching with [bot] stripping) and objective syntax/lint checks pass. Deductions for unused LAST_ACTIONABLE_TIME, in-loop comments acknowledging incomplete timestamp handling, pr-resolve-all.md overclaiming dedicated GraphQL usage while the script uses gh pr view --json reviewThreads, and embedding all snapshot logic directly in the poll loop without extractable fixtures or modular helpers.

process.rationale: Diff is focused on seven on-task files (helper, allow-list, required prompt/docs, check inventories) with no forbidden live-state surfaces, PLAN.md, or AGENTS.md churn; pr-resolve-all.md and op-issue-workflow.md preserve the documented time-based fallback. One point withheld because the task explicitly requested shell-test wiring but no scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats or dedicated pr-resolve-all-poll check script appears in files-changed.txt.

reliability.rationale: Verification is thin: objective test_wiring failed (0/2 patterns), bats_poll_helper was skipped, and the diff adds only generic required-file and script-inventory entries in 010-required-files.sh and 105-scripts.sh. bash -n and lint-shell-conventions pass, but no behavioral tests exercise exit-contract paths (CONVERGED gating, SHA_CHANGED, QUIET_ELAPSED math, API_ERROR) and the bundle contains no run transcript beyond objective automation.
